text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet came to watch the Japanese 
Derby, but—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after the race, you can't get Vodka's 
spirited run—and the sight of her standing 
as number one—out of your head.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wanted to defeat the girl who had 
snatched away the "Number One" spot she 
desired—Daiwa Scarlet's eyes burned with 
fierce intensity.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her next destination is the Shuka Sho, the 
final leg of the Triple Tiara.
